caption: The drawing depicts a small wooden table or bench with a light brown color. The structure consists of a rectangular top surface with visible wood grain, two vertical side panels each with a semi-circular cutout near the top, and a shelf situated between the side panels below the tabletop. Beneath this shelf, there is a single horizontal drawer with a brass-colored handle. The side panels extend below the drawer, ending in a simple, notched base. The table is shown in a three-quarter perspective view. In the lower left corner of the drawing, a smaller schematic inset illustrates the bench in a front view with dimensions noted. The background is an off-white, unadorned paper with a faint pencil-drawn rectangle acting as a border around the main image. The name "Vincent Basel" and the year "1864" are written in the lower right corner outside the main rectangle.
title: Kitchen Bench Table
